title: MV Do you know any add-on that uses armor as additional hp? rpg maker mv

posts.author: Cradle
posts.body:
Hello, as the title says, my idea is to put armor as additional HP, like the armor model that exists in "divinity original sin 2"
I have tried things, like Absorption Barrier (YEP) by yanfly, and it is fine, but I don't know if it is possible, or do you know something that can calculate your armor, and add it as an additional life bar.
Greetings and thanks!

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You can make your armor increase Max HP right in its database entry.
Just saying "like divinity original sin 2" doesn't mean anything to the many people who have never played that game.
What's the purpose of it being a separate life bar?

posts.author: Cradle
posts.body:
The idea is that there is no damage reduction, since it is sometimes difficult for me to do the calculations, nothing is done to the tank, and the mage explodes.
The idea of having a separate bar makes it easier for me to manage, for example a warrior could wear heavy armor, and this would give him armor hp of, for example, 100, and the mage would have light armor of 20, and Once that armor is removed, the damage would go to the character's hp.
That is the example

purpose

posts.author: Cradle
posts.body:
ATT_Turan said:
On the one hand, it's easier for me to manage than armor calculations, I guess it's a matter of taste.
On the other hand, the idea is that I can last longer in long dungeons without having to resort to healing so much, for example you can face more enemies without your life going down so much, since those shields are renewed every battle.
The two bars are to represent physical and magical defense, you can wear full armor and have a lot of physical armor, but a wizard could easily hurt you if you don't have magical armor.
Click to expand...

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Cradle said:
you can face more enemies without your life going down so much, since those shields are renewed every battle.
Click to expand...
Okay,
that
is the description you needed to give. It also is very different from your opening post, because it means this is really not "like additional HP."
I would personally recommend you keep using absorption barrier for this - it doesn't have the two different physical and elemental barriers, but so much work is already done for you. Having the notetags, integrating the math into battle calculations, adding the gauge to the UI, that's not simple work.
I would expect that if you have to have the two gauges for different kinds of attacks, you'll probably have to hire someone to make that for you.
Another route would be to use Yanfly's Buffs and States core which has counters - numbers that can be printed on the icons of states.
It's not a gauge, but you could have a state each for physical and magical armor and use the counters to display how many points they have left to absorb.

So when you start a battle, you'll start with a barrier for the 100 giving you a total of 350 at the start of the battle.
